title: Normalization on finite multiplication generators
statement: For a prime l, finite E/Q_l, scheme isomorphism g, complex P and a natural transformation a from its pullback quotient tower to inverse image of its quotient tower, TrfMultiplicationGeneratorNormalized means that a sends each specified sheafified pullback unit generator to its original section at every degree, level and pro-etale object. The tower map need not be invertible.

lean.statement:
def TrfMultiplicationGeneratorNormalized
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (a : (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E g).obj P ⟶
      (trfInverseImageTower l E g).obj ((trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y).obj P)) : Prop
